tipEnabled: When enabled, pages open as tabs so you can switch quickly between multiple pages.
tipAllowPersonalization: Lets each user tune appearance and close behavior in their own browser. When off, the personal-preference page is disabled.
tipMaxTabs: Maximum number of tabs that can be open at once. 0 = unlimited (any number of tabs).
tipMaxBehavior: What happens when the limit is reached: auto-close the least recently used tab, or stop opening new tabs.
tipCornerRadius: Corner radius for the Rounded style, in px. Range 0–16, default 5. Applies only when style is Rounded.
tipBarPosition: Where the bar is mounted: over the whole page (including above the sidebar), or just right of the sidebar.
tipFixedWidth: Whether every tab uses the same width. On: tabs have a fixed width. Off: adaptive — you must set the minimum and maximum widths allowed for a tab.
tipFixedTabWidth: Width of each tab when fixed width is on, in px.
tipMinTabWidth: Minimum tab width in adaptive mode, in px.
tipMaxTabWidth: Maximum tab width in adaptive mode, in px; longer titles are truncated with an ellipsis.
tipTabHeight: Tab bar height, in px. Changing it also shifts the sidebar and page header vertically so their tops stay aligned with the bar's bottom.
tipShowMenuIcon: Show the menu icon before the tab title. If a menu has no icon, no space is reserved.
tipShowRefresh: Show a refresh button at the far right of the bar.
tipCloseButtonMode: When the close button appears: always / on tab hover / only on the active tab.
tipMiddleClickClose: Close a tab with the mouse middle button.
tipContextMenu: Enable the right-click menu: pin / close left / close right / close others / close all.
tipPinFirstTab: Pin the first opened page so it cannot be closed. Note: if the corresponding portal has “Default tabs” or “Pinned tabs” configured, this option has no effect — the first tab follows the portal config instead.
pinFirstTabDisabledNote: When the corresponding portal has default or pinned tabs configured, “Pin first tab” has no effect: the first tab from the portal config is treated as the first tab, and tabs the user opens later are not pinned.
tipKeepAtLeastOne: Always keep at least one tab open.
tipRestoreAfterRefresh: Restore previously opened tabs after a browser refresh (F5).
tipDefaultTabs: Tabs opened by default for every user, configured by the admin (title / path / icon). The path is the in-app route path starting with “/”, e.g. /admin/abc. If the site is deployed under a prefix (e.g. /v), the plugin adapts the prefix automatically — do not include the prefix or domain.
tipPinnedTabs: Always-present, non-closable tabs configured by the admin (title / path / icon). Same path rule as above: an in-app route path starting with “/”, e.g. /admin/abc. A deployment prefix (e.g. /v) is adapted automatically, so do not enter the full domain or the prefixed URL.
personalNote: Personal preferences are stored only in your browser. They override the global default and take effect after a page refresh.
tipIconHelper: Icon: click “Select icon” to open a popover where you can filter by style and search. Leave empty to use the menu's own icon.
portalTabsHint: Set default and pinned tabs per portal here. A portal is identified by its NocoBase multi-portal “portalName” — the same portal resolves to one name whether deployed at /v/admin or /x/admin, while /v/admin and /x/admin are two DIFFERENT portals. Portals without their own entry fall back to the “Default (all portals)” setting above. The bar applies the right tabs by the current portal name at runtime; switching portals shows only that portal's tabs. A tab path only needs to be an in-app route starting with “/” — no manual deployment sub-path or domain needed.
portalSelectHint: Select a portal, then set its default and pinned tabs; saving applies to all users. A tab path only needs to be an in-app route starting with “/”.
tipPortalScope: Choose which portal to configure; empty means the shared default that applies to every portal without its own entry.
